description: Send an email. Returns a preview and sends NOTHING on the first call: review the preview, then call again with the same arguments plus the confirmToken it returned (or confirm=true where the policy allows the tool) to deliver.

attach.description: Absolute paths of files to attach.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Omitted or false returns a dry-run preview.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report what the call would do without doing it.

from.description: Sending account name (from mail_accounts). Defaults to the primary account.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

title: mail_send: arguments
